scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 — a valid `{path}` span in a NON-interpolation-eligible position (a `where`-predicate string literal, an expression operand) is a compile error (DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_INERT_POSITION), not silent literal text. Interpolation is action-argument-only; without this diagnostic the span ships inert. Pin: `where s.obj == "m-{s.obj}"`.
rules_ds:
schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

rule r:
    Src s where s.obj == "m-{s.obj}"
->
    log info "done"
